mapper.sql: CREDIT_PLAN_ID, CREDIT_AMT, QUOTA_TYPE, CONGLOMERATE_FLAG, BELONG_CONGLOMERATE, DATE_FROM, DATE_TO, CREDIT_DESC, FINANCE_NOTE, OTHER, OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER, REQUEST_ID, PROGRAM_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN, SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID,CHANGE_BEFORE_CREDIT_AMT,DATE_TO_BEFORE
mapper.select: select v.*, (v.credit_amt - v.used_amount) left_credit_amt from ( select hcp.credit_plan_id, hcp.down_payment_ratio, HCP.deposit_ratio, pp.project_id, -- 承租人 (select wm_concat(hbm.bp_name) from hls_bp_master hbm, prj_project_bp ppb where ppb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and ppb.bp_type = 'MANUFACTURER' and ppb.project_id = pp.project_id) as tenants, -- 租赁方式 pp.business_type, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'HLS200.LEASING_PRODUCT_DETAIL' AND v.code_value = pp.business_type AND v.enabled_flag = 'Y' ) AS business_type_n, -- 资金用途 pp.finance_note, -- 其他 hcp.other, -- 租赁物信息 pp.lease_matter_note, -- 担保方式 pp.guarantee_method_note, hcp.credit_amt, /*这里要等付款支付改造完成后取值*/ 0 used_amount, hcp.quota_type, hcp.conglomerate_flag, hcp.belong_conglomerate, hcp.date_from, hcp.date_to, hcp.credit_desc, hcp.source_document_category, hcp.source_document_id, hcp.irr, hcp.financing_date, ( select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = hcp.CONGLOMERATE_FLAG ) CONGLOMERATE_FLAG_N, ( select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'FINANCING_LOAN' and scv.value = hcp.QUOTA_TYPE ) QUOTA_TYPE_N, hcp.non_cyclical_amount, hcp.cyclical_amount, hcp.bear_guarantee_flag, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND v.code_value = hcp.bear_guarantee_flag) bear_guarantee_flag_n, hcp.floating_range_method, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'CON.FLOATING_RANGE_METHOD' and v.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND v.code_value = hcp.floating_range_method) floating_range_method_n, hcp.GUARANTEE_METHOD, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'GUARANTEE_METHOD' and v.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND v.code_value = hcp.GUARANTEE_METHOD) GUARANTEE_METHOD_N, hcp.guarantee_method_rent, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and v.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND v.code_value = hcp.guarantee_method_rent) guarantee_method_rent_n, hcp.guarantee_method_difference, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and v.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND v.code_value = hcp.guarantee_method_difference) guarantee_method_difference_n, hcp.guarantee_method_repurcharse, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and v.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND v.code_value = hcp.guarantee_method_repurcharse) guarantee_method_repurcharse_n, hcp.guarantee_method_response, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and v.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND v.code_value = hcp.guarantee_method_response) guarantee_method_response_n, hcp.annual_pay_times, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'HLS500_ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES' and v.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND v.code_value = hcp.annual_pay_times) annual_pay_times_n, hcp.residual_price_type, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'RESIDUAL_PRICE_TYPE' and v.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND v.code_value = hcp.residual_price_type) residual_price_type_n, HCP.residual from prj_project pp, hls_credit_plan hcp where hcp.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'PRJ_PROJECT' and hcp.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = pp.project_id and pp.project_id = #{projectId} )v

select hcp.credit_plan_id, pp.project_id, -- 承租人 (select wm_concat(hbm.bp_name) from hls_bp_master hbm, prj_project_bp ppb where ppb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and ppb.bp_type = 'COOPERATIVE_ORGANIZATION' and ppb.project_id = pp.project_id) as tenants, -- 租赁方式 pp.business_type, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'HLS200.LEASING_PRODUCT_DETAIL' AND v.code_value = pp.business_type AND v.enabled_flag = 'Y' ) AS business_type_n, -- 资金用途 pp.finance_note, -- 其他 hcp.other, -- 租赁物信息 pp.lease_matter_note, -- 担保方式 pp.guarantee_method_note, hcp.credit_amt, hcp.quota_type , hcp.conglomerate_flag , hcp.belong_conglomerate , hcp.date_from , hcp.date_to , hcp.credit_desc , hcp.source_document_category , hcp.source_document_id , hcp.irr, hcp.financing_date, ( select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = hcp.CONGLOMERATE_FLAG ) CONGLOMERATE_FLAG_N, ( select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'FINANCING_LOAN' and scv.value = hcp.QUOTA_TYPE ) QUOTA_TYPE_N from prj_project pp, hls_credit_plan hcp where hcp.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'PRJ_PROJECT' and hcp.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = pp.project_id and pp.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT c.bp_id, ( SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = c.bp_id ) bp_name, hcp.credit_amt, hcp.quota_type, ( select sc.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v sc where sc.code = 'FINANCING_LOAN' AND sc.code_value = hcp.QUOTA_TYPE ) QUOTA_TYPE_N, hcp.date_from, hcp.date_to, hcp.credit_desc FROM hls_credit_plan hcp INNER JOIN hls_credit_line_chance c ON hcp.source_document_category = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE_CHANCE' AND hcp.source_document_id = c.chance_id
c.chance_id = #{chanceId}
